desc: A crunchy, whole grain oat granola bar made from a blend of whole grain rolled oats with real peanut butter. Individually wrapped, with 2 bars per package, for a healthy, on-the-go snack. Made without Gelatin, no artificial flavors, no colors from artificial sources, and no high fructose corn syrup. For crediting in USDA Child Nutrition Programs: 1 ounce equivalent grain and whole grain-rich criteria. Available in bulk, 6 boxes of 18 - 1.49 oz bars.
features:
A crunchy, whole grain oat granola bar made from a blend of whole grain rolled oats with real peanut butter.

Individually wrapped, with 2 bars per package. Available in bulk, 6 boxes of 18 - 1.49 oz bars.

A crunchy granola bar made with rich, creamy peanut butter drizzled over 100% nautral whole grain oats.

For crediting in USDA Child Nutrition Programs: 1 ounce equivalent grain and whole grain-rich criteria.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Rice Flour, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Baking Soda, Soy Lecithin.
